blocks.text:
## What to expect on this journey

The Pantanal is ideal for travellers who want to spend several days among wetlands, rivers, grasslands and forests, watching wildlife in its natural habitat. The excursions available depend on the weather and season: options may include horseback rides, jeep safaris, boat trips and guided walks. Activities are arranged at the lodge, and early departures increase your chances of seeing wildlife.

Bonito is known for its crystal-clear rivers, caves, waterfalls and adventure activities. The programme features a walk at Estância Mimosa, Blue Lake Cave, snorkelling in the Rio Sucuri, rafting and the Arvorismo – Cabanas high-ropes course. A descent into the Abismo Anhumas cave can be booked as an optional extra.
